split_manifest.boundary_rule: Start inclusive, end exclusive; timestamps have no supplied timezone.
split_manifest.selection_reason: Main benchmark covers dense September 1-10 activity. September 11-18 has sparse activity and a sharply different label rate in the full-file audit, so it is retained as a separate tail evaluation.
split_manifest.scope: Split creation only. No resampling, duplicate removal, feature fitting, or training.
split_manifest.currency_policy: Original currency strings retained. No exchange conversion applied.
split_manifest.account_identity: Use (bank, account) pairs; transaction IDs are not model features.
split_manifest.target: label is derived from Is Laundering; never use it as a predictor.
split_manifest.ordered_read: SELECT * FROM transactions ORDER BY timestamp, transaction_id
split_manifest.history_rule: History features must use events strictly earlier than each scored timestamp. A transaction_id tie-break is only for reproducible output; it does not establish causal order among same-time events. Fit transforms on training rows only.
split_manifest.evaluation_rule: Tune on validation only. Reserve test and tail labels for final evaluation. Report tail results separately; do not pool them into the main headline metrics.

category_encoding: One-hot: unknown=0, known_i uses vocabulary[i-1]. Fitted on training only.
time_units: Seconds since time_origin; source timezone is unspecified.
history_policy: Counts and recency use strictly earlier timestamps. All rows at the same timestamp see the same prior history. Updates never use labels.
evaluation_policy: Sequential scoring: prior unlabeled validation/test events may update history for later events. The model itself is not refitted on those events.
currency_policy: Whitespace removed and text uppercased for currency categories. Amounts stay in their original currencies; no cross-currency totals are computed.
amount_availability: Both paid and received amounts are used for retrospective transaction scoring. A pre-transfer demo must omit any value not yet known.
history_scope: Cumulative incoming/outgoing transaction counts and recency. Not unique-neighbor degrees; no rolling windows, pair counts, or graph embeddings yet.
cold_start: Zero counts and has_prior_* flags identify accounts without prior events.
label_balance: Every source transaction retained; no oversampling or downsampling.
files: For each split: X inputs, y targets, transaction_ids, time_seconds, edges. Row i aligns across these five arrays. edges[:,0] is sender and edges[:,1] receiver.
